entries.summary: Pi 1.6.0 changes closureDigest and requires new preparations. The keys catalog follows pi-ai 1.6.0 and removed entries return not_in_catalog. Replicas with pi.tool v4 or pi.generation v3 cannot resume on Pi 1.5.2. Pi now pins undici 8.12.4.

@byok-sdk/client and @byok-sdk/client/adapters DshAdapter (DaemonConfig.runtimes.dsh) open every DSH session with sessionLogUpload 'off', so official DeepSeek requests no longer carry dsh_session_log. The dsh_plugin_packages request field is unchanged. If DSH cannot confirm the uploader is off, the open fails non-retryably with an UnsupportedOptionError (option 'sessionLogUpload') before any model request. Use a qualified DSH build that honors the setting, such as 0.2.2-rc.1, and do not rely on SDK tasks to upload DeepSeek session logs.
